ex.en: I was given a nice watch by my uncle.
ex.zh: 叔叔送了我一支漂亮的手錶。

ex.en: Mother gives my sister two thousand yen every month.
ex.zh: 媽媽每個月給妹妹兩千日圓。

ex.en: She will give a presentation tomorrow.
ex.zh: 她明天要做簡報。

ex.en: Can you give me some advice?
ex.zh: 你可以給我一些建議嗎？

ex.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
ex.zh: 我可能很快就會放棄，乾脆去睡個午覺。

ex.en: Don't give up on your dream.
ex.zh: 不要放棄你的夢想。

ex.en: I have to give back the book before Saturday.
ex.zh: 我必須在星期六前把書還回去。

ex.en: Please give back the keys before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請歸還鑰匙。

ex.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 那個女孩脖子上圍著一條長圍巾。

ex.en: There are more girls than boys in this school.
ex.zh: 這所學校女生比男生多。

ex.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
ex.zh: 梅格是唯一穿牛仔褲的女生。

ex.en: Tom asked Mary to buy a gift for John.
ex.zh: 湯姆請瑪麗幫忙買一份禮物給約翰。

ex.en: Tom brings us gifts whenever he visits.
ex.zh: 湯姆每次來看我們都會帶禮物。

ex.en: She has a gift for languages.
ex.zh: 她很有語言天分。

ex.en: He has a real gift for teaching.
ex.zh: 他真的很有教學天分。

ex.en: No one gifted us anything.
ex.zh: 沒有人送我們任何東西。

ex.en: He gifted his old car to his nephew.
ex.zh: 他把舊車送給了姪子。

ex.en: I've never seen such a giant watermelon!
ex.zh: 我從沒看過這麼大的西瓜！

ex.en: Seen from the sky, this river looks like a giant snake.
ex.zh: 從空中看，這條河像一條巨蛇。

ex.en: Apple is a tech giant.
ex.zh: 蘋果是科技巨頭。

ex.en: The retail giant plans to open fifty new stores.
ex.zh: 這家零售巨頭打算開五十家新店。

ex.en: The giraffe was walking along the river bank.
ex.zh: 長頸鹿沿著河岸走著。

ex.en: What sound does a giraffe make?
ex.zh: 長頸鹿是怎麼叫的？

ex.en: The kids loved feeding the giraffes at the zoo.
ex.zh: 孩子們很喜歡在動物園餵長頸鹿。

ex.en: At what age did you have your first girlfriend?
ex.zh: 你幾歲交了第一個女朋友？

ex.en: Tom took his girlfriend out on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 星期六晚上湯姆帶女朋友出去約會。

ex.en: Tom has had a lot of girlfriends.
ex.zh: 湯姆交過很多女朋友。

ex.en: The video file is nearly two gigabytes in size.
ex.zh: 這個影片檔將近兩 GB。

ex.en: The tablet has 128 gigabytes of storage.
ex.zh: 這台平板有 128 GB 的儲存空間。

ex.en: The store offered a reusable bag as a giveaway with each purchase.
ex.zh: 商店推出每筆消費贈送環保袋的活動。

ex.en: The logo on the package was a giveaway that it was a sample.
ex.zh: 包裝上的標誌明顯透露那是樣品。

ex.en: Gift wrap is available at the service counter.
ex.zh: 服務櫃檯提供禮品包裝。

ex.en: She asked the cashier to gift wrap the vase.
ex.zh: 她請收銀員把花瓶包裝成禮物。
